💰 MI SB 0980 — Michigan to Block New Crypto Kiosk Installations

Michigan is banning the setup and operation of cryptocurrency kiosks. The bill defines key terms like 'cryptocurrency' and 'cryptocurrency kiosk' – essentially, any machine that lets you buy or trade crypto with regular money. It prohibits anyone from installing or running these kiosks, and sets fines of up to $10,000 for violations. The goal is to protect consumers from potential fraud associated with these new financial technologies. ...
